patch_description: Rebalancing the feature-upload vs. ansatz-repeat schedule to N_UPLOADS=2, N_REPEATS=3. This maintains the total of six blocks (2×3=6) so depth stays near 105 but shifts toward deeper variational processing per data injection. This mutation explores the trade-off between encoding frequency and circuit expressivity, leveraging the insight that optimal depth is around 95–105 layers. Maintaining gate_count~300 ensures fair comparison to the current best.
